title: ✔️ Certificate Requirement Updated!
body:
We’ve updated the certificate requirements for the typing course. **Special Symbols are no longer required** for the certificate. You now only need to complete the practice requirements for the **3 main chapters**.

To apply this update, please **delete the typing course and download it again**. Don’t worry—this will **not affect your existing results, progress, or user settings**. Your data will remain safe, and the updated certificate requirements will be applied automatically after downloading the course again.

Thank you for your patience and for helping us improve USTAAD Typing!

title: ✔️ Arabic Typing Course Updated!
body:
We’ve fixed several major bugs in the **Arabic typing course**, including issues that could cause incorrect characters to appear or prevent you from completing certain lessons.

If you are currently **stuck anywhere in the Arabic typing course**, please **delete the Arabic typing course and download it again**. This will install the updated course material with the fixes.

Don’t worry—deleting and downloading the course again will **not affect your existing results, progress, or user settings**.

Thank you for reporting these issues and helping us improve USTAAD Typing!
